items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: The interviewee does not mention 'Kay' directly; the interviewer mentions 'Sister Kay' in the context of Louis Armstrong playing a tune, but the interviewee's response focuses on Clarence Williams, Pierron, and Louis Armstrong, showing no personal connection to Kay.

ctx.x: The only one I heard that any composing was Clarence Williams, you know, and Pierron. Yeah, they know that too. And I heard of them.
Yeah, they were the ones who'd write it down. That's right. That's right. The other guys must have done some composing. Louis, I mean, he didn't. No, he got Sister Kay, he just played it.
Yeah. And Pierron wrote it, you see. Yeah. Yeah, but poor Louis, he just. Just made it up. Yeah, just made it up.
